explanation: Lesotho was once Basutoland, Botswana was Bechuanaland and Malawi was Nyasaland, names from the era of British rule.

claims.text: Eswatini was formerly known in English as Swaziland.
Lesotho, Botswana and Malawi were never known as Swaziland.
Lesotho was formerly Basutoland, Botswana was formerly Bechuanaland and Malawi was formerly Nyasaland.
Basutoland, Bechuanaland and Nyasaland were names used under British rule.

writerNotes: Self-check (§9.3). Lint: content:check reports no errors or warnings for this item. Claims: every checkable statement is listed; c1 is a name that changed in recent years, so high (recent_change); the rest are standard. Datasets: cldr-territories en territories.json: SZ 'Eswatini', SZ-alt-variant 'Swaziland' (c1); mledoze-countries cca3=SWZ name Eswatini. Rival test: Lesotho is the twin in size and setting (another small southern African kingdom), which makes it the main pull; Botswana and Malawi are other former British territories. Against the key: none. Volatility: evergreen, settled geography with no review date; no time words, and nothing depends on knowledge newer than mid-2026. Regional: a renaming that was world news; the old name is still widely remembered. Style: Oxford spelling, plain hyphens only, straight quotes, explanation of 18 words. Myths: every claim screened against content/reference/myths.json; no match. Mystery and encore: nothing of either kind to check in a practice item. Doubts: none. I left out the 2018 date so the key rests on the dataset alone.

claimResults.note: CLDR gives Eswatini as the English name with Swaziland as its variant; mledoze-countries cca3=SWZ also lists Swaziland in altSpellings. The 2018 renaming itself is from knowledge.

evidence.restatement: Lesotho, Botswana and Malawi each had their own colonial names, none of them Swaziland.
Basutoland became Lesotho, Bechuanaland became Botswana and Nyasaland became Malawi.
Basutoland, Bechuanaland and Nyasaland were British protectorates.

claimResults.note: The rename (announced by the king in April 2018) is knowledge, certain.
